text: Because of the Chiang Mai Dental University, there is an abundance of excellent dentists in the city. Like pharmacies, they are everywhere and the choice can be confusing. So i'm just giving a shout out to these guys @ Hollywood Smile. I will avoid dentists if I can, so the super professional staff make this gruesome chore a lot easier to handle.

Flew from the USA and had several appointments last Spring and had the best dental care ever! Extremely professional and knowledgeable. Friendly staff and reasonably priced.

I returned and now intend on having a few other procedures done. Great Job Hollywood Smiles Chiangmai!
Booked and seen the same day. I am very impressed with the results. Went for a clean and the dentist and two hygienists worked on me for 40 mins. Paid 1500 baht. Would highly recommend!

Rushed, lazy teeth cleaning. Took less than 20 minutes, the dentist barely did anything. Couldn't see or feel a difference when I left. 800 baht. Never going back.

They may have different dentists there. The one I got looks like if Dustin Hoffman were unshaven and Thai.
Staff very frienly and very nice owner

text: My history is that I have an air flow scaling service, which is a promotional price of 1,000 baht, 100 baht more expensive than a normal scaling service. So I came to get an air flow scaling service. I told him what I was here to do. When I went upstairs, the doctor did a normal scaling service. Holy crap! There are hundreds of dental clinics in Chiang Mai. Why would I get my teeth cleaned here if I wasn't going to get an air flow service? What an idiot!

I chose to get my braces done here. The clinic is clean.
The staff are polite and provide excellent service.
The doctor gave very good advice.
Extremely impressed! ❤️❤️❤️
